name: qianhuiwu/GUI-Actor-7B-Qwen2.5-VL-LiteTrain
summary: A GUI-grounding checkpoint built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct with an attention-based action head. Its example predicts a click point from a screenshot and instruction.

name: InternVL3_5-2B
summary: InternVL3.5-2B checkpoint with a 0.3B vision encoder and 2.0B language model, from a multimodal family trained with Cascade RL that lists GUI interaction among its capabilities.

name: Seg2Click Qwen3.5 2B
summary: Seg2Click checkpoint using a 2B Qwen3.5 backbone to predict a mask and select an interface click.

name: ScaleCUA 7B
summary: A Qwen2.5-VL-based computer-use checkpoint with direct grounding and agent action modes across desktop, mobile and web interfaces.

name: Magma-AITW-SoM
summary: Magma-AITW-SoM supplies AITW data used to fine-tune the Magma multimodal agent model for downstream tasks.
